method: hand derivation from xcrun objdump -d --macho, xcrun otool -Iv, xcrun nm -n; no src/, tests/ or notes read

sites.tier2_explanation: Xm is x22. It is defined by ldp x20,x22,[sp,#8] at 0x100000cbc, a stack load of the out-parameter that swift_getErrorValue (stub call at 0x100000cb8, x2=sp+8) wrote through a pointer. It is not the x0 result of a decided metadata accessor or of a listed runtime function, and it is not a mov copy of one. Stack transport stays refused.

sites.tier2_reason: admitted_only_by_section_5_amendment (strict v1 would refuse: import stub symbol not on the five-name runtime list)
sites.tier2_explanation: Xm is x24, a mov copy (0xf28) of x0 returned by bl to the import stub for _$sSS10FoundationE8EncodingVMa (0xf24), an attributed import stub whose symbol is a metadata accessor entity. Table register x26 = ldur [x0,#-8] at 0xf2c, taken straight from that x0. Straight-line code from 0xf24 to 0xf9c with no branch or join. x24 and x26 are not written between definition and use (callee-saved across the bl/blr in between; no explicit write). Condition 1 and 3 hold.

Xm is x22 = mov of x0 (0x100001210) after bl 0x100000d98. That target is a local function with no symbol (nm shows only _main and __mh_execute_header as defined). It is a generic lazy-metadata-cache helper taking x0=cache address, x1=mangled-name reference (calls swift_getTypeByMangledNameInContext), not a $s...Ma accessor, and it cannot be decided by the declaration grammar. Not an import stub and not a listed runtime function. Condition 3 would hold (x22 and x27 unwritten, no join into 0x12a4) but condition 2 fails first.

Prior hint is not a blr. It is 'br x2', an indirect tail branch, so it is not in the blr census of __text. If an engine counts indirect br as a call row it would classify as value_witness slot +0x8 (ldur x8,[x1,#-8]; ldrb w9,[x8,#0x52]; tbnz; ldr x2,[x8,#0x8]; br x2) and tier 2 would refuse it at condition 2: Xm is x1 = ldr [x0,#0x18], a load from an entry-register object, not a metadata-accessor result.

Xm is x23 = mov of x0 (0x1000013a4) after bl 0x100000d98, the same symbol-less local cache helper as site 0x1000012a4. Table register x28 = ldur [x0,#-8] (0x1000013a8). Condition 2 fails; condition 3 would hold.

derivation: Original hand derivation kept unchanged for every site it listed; the oracle was not adapted to the code on any class, slot, condition or admission.

Correction 1 (oracle incomplete): site 0x10000135c is an indirect tail branch (br). The implementation's scan counts br and blr alike as indirect-call instructions, and the design says every indirect-call row gets a tier 1 record. The oracle's own hint check already derived its result (value_witness, slot 0x8, refused at condition 2); it is promoted to a site with site_kind br.

Correction 2 (scope): the three got_or_global_fnptr sites (0x100000f40, 0x10000122c, 0x1000013c0) are GOT calls that the existing GOT model attributes to a non-Swift import (___chkstk_darwin). They are not indirect-call rows and not got_base_not_adrp declines, so design section 2 gives them no tier 1 record. Their class is kept as the oracle's hand classification and marked in_report false; the report must carry no shape or admission record for them and must count them as non_swift_got_calls.
